notes.title: The Heave Ho Soundtrack is Available Now!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is Fred and Alex from Le Cartel. We released [i]Heave H[/i]o six years ago, and it’s incredible to see so many people still laughing and cursing together with our game. Thank you![/p][p]We probably should have done this years ago, but today we are releasing Camille Giraudeau’s brilliant [i]Heave Ho[/i] soundtrack on Steam. His music is such an important part of [i]Heave Ho[/i], and we couldn’t imagine the game without it.[/p][p]And because he is a super kind guy, he’s remastered it so it sounds better than ever. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3855960/Heave_Ho_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]By the way, did you know that Camille has another life as a black metal musician, including drumming with Norwegian extreme metal band Dødheimsgard? We wanted to know more, so we asked him a few questions...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35187021/b42482a1373d0d12b1a81f4aeb7a29061a43b58b.jpg"][/img][i]When he's not composing music for Heave Ho, Camille (left) plays drums for DHG.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]How do you make sense of composing the music for [i]Heave Ho[/i] and drumming with Dødheimsgard (DHG)?[/b][/h3][p][i]Camille: I've actually got two parallel careers: metal and game audio! My dream is obviously to combine the two, but I haven’t had the chance yet![/i][/p][h3][b]Do you put [i]Heave Ho[/i] vibes into your drumming with DHG? Or does DHG make your game soundtracks more metal?[/b][/h3][p][i]Camille: There are some hardcore Heave Ho fans in DHG, but I can’t really say I put Heave Ho into the sound — it’s more the other way around. Avant-garde metal in general definitely leaves its mark on my game audio work :) DHG and Doedsmaghird for sure, but also bands like Ved Buens Ende, Virus (I played bass for them), Mr. Bungle, Fleurety, Stagnant Waters, Gorguts, Fantômas, and Dreams of the Drowned.[/i][/p][h3][b]Why did you want to remaster the [i]Heave Ho[/i] OST? [/b][/h3][p][i]Camille: I think this remaster helps bring the Heave Ho OST closer to what I really wanted it to sound like back then — but using the skills I’ve picked up since! I’m still super proud of that music. I think it stood out for being genuinely unique and individual, which isn’t always easy in an industry that doesn’t always encourage that.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p]If you still need persuading that the Heave Ho soundtrack is amazing and you should buy it now, here are some of the inspiring and thoughtful comments left on tracks from the OST on YouTube:[/p][p]
“I listen to this when I'm high af”[/p][p]“My friend has a seizure when this song played”[/p][p]“So stupid, so perfect.”[/p][p]
Enjoy!
Fred & Alex
Le Cartel, Paris, France[/p]

notes.title: New Versus Mode available!
notes.content:
Good news everyone! The ‘Versus Mode’ officially leaves its beta state to become entirely part of the game. Race across 20 new levels and be the first to reach the end to help your team win. Grab, push and fart on your opponents, no holds barred!  Ready to ruin more friendships?

This big update contains:

- Versus Mode with 20 exclusive new levels
- New costumes
- New options allowing you to setup gameplay rules
- Better-looking menu for Solo Mode
- Best time is displayed for each level rather than for each world
- Assistance Gloves are bigger
- More powerful farts! 
- More physics on paint ejections!

notes.title: The new versus mode available (BETA)
notes.content:
EXCITING NEWS: The new Heave Ho ‘Versus Mode’ beta with 20 new levels is available on Steam and we want your feedback!

Description: 

Players choose a team and prepare for a race - 2 vs 2, 3 vs 1, or every player for themselves! 
The first team to reach the goal wins, it’s as simple as that! The match is over once a team reaches five points!  

How to Download?

To download the beta, go to the settings of Heave Ho > Beta tab > Choose "publicbetaversusmode". The game will be updated automatically. Just update the game on Steam and play the beta version of Versus Mode right away! 

Then?

Enjoy 20 new levels to liven up your competitive spirit and ruin your friendships! Once we get your helpful feedback, we'll fix bugs and balance these new 20 levels!

notes.title: Patch Note 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We were able to fix a lot of things thanks to your feedback. Here's the list:

Bug fixes:

- Default Keyboard and binding
- Token getting stuck after a few reset
- Trophy Collector
- Missing assets for grey tokens
- Faces that appeared in score recap behind hair styles that are supposed to hide the entire face
- Main menu getting stuck with left input on
- Best score display in level selection
- Multiple musics at the same time
- Players getting stuck in a mini-game loop after adding new players during a game
- Post Processing and ratio in mini-games and circus level
- Borderless graphic option
- 5th players could be added during a game
- Keyboard icons in character selection
- Playstation controller icons size
- Typos and missing localized texts
- Various errors appearing in the output log
